enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn over. Pull blanket up. Continue sleeping.

Turn on light. Turn on water heater. Undress. Step into shower. Turn on shower. Wet body. Apply soap and scrub. Rinse. Shampoo and rinse hair. Turn off shower. Dry with towel. Turn off water heater and light. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Preparing and eating breakfast with Member 1
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Greet Member 1: 'Good morning.' Open refrigerator. Take out eggs, milk, bread. Place on counter. Take out frying pan. Turn on induction cooker. Crack eggs into pan. Stir eggs. Toast bread in toaster. Pour milk into glasses. Set plates and utensils on table. Sit down. Eat breakfast. Talk with Member 1. Drink milk. Finish eating. Clear dishes.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and organizing the freelance illustration to-do list for the day
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to Bedroom 2. Open wardrobe. Pick out shirt and pants. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Walk to desk. Turn on desk lamp. Sit at desk. Open computer. Open to-do list app. Type tasks for freelance illustration. Check calendar. Write down deadlines. Save list. Close computer.

enriched_activities.activity: Light stretching and reviewing the day's work-from-home schedule
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Roll out yoga mat. Stand on mat. Stretch arms overhead. Bend forward. Stretch legs. Sit on sofa. Pick up phone. Open calendar app. Review work-from-home schedule. Scroll through events. Make notes. Put down phone. Stand up. Roll up mat. Walk to bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Working at the desk on arts administration tasks: emails, grant paperwork, and program scheduling
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Turn on computer. Open email client. Read emails. Reply to emails. Open grant application document. Fill out forms. Save document. Open program scheduling software. Schedule events. Make phone calls. Take notes. Adjust desk lamp. Use monitor. Take breaks. Stand up. Stretch. Sit down again. Continue working. Save files. Close programs.

Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out leftovers. Place in microwave. Heat food. Take out plate. Sit at table. Eat lunch. Drink water. Finish eating. Clean dishes. Put dishes in dishwasher. Wipe table. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Short break, stretching and resting eyes away from the screen
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Close eyes. Rub eyes. Stretch arms. Stand up. Walk around room. Sit back down. Pick up magazine. Flip through pages. Put down magazine. Walk to bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Freelance illustration work on the computer, drafting and refining artwork on the monitor
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Open computer. Open illustration software. Create new canvas. Pick up digital pen. Sketch initial draft. Use monitor to view artwork. Adjust colors. Refine lines. Save file. Open reference image. Zoom in. Zoom out. Add details. Take break. Stand up. Stretch. Sit down. Continue drawing. Save final version. Close software.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing after work and watching TV
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Sit on sofa. Browse channels. Select program. Watch TV. Adjust volume. Change channel. Watch more TV. Turn off TV. Stand up. Walk to kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking dinner using the induction cooker and oven
enriched_activities.desc: Enter kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables, meat. Place on counter. Wash vegetables. Chop vegetables. Turn on induction cooker. Place pan on cooker. Add oil. Add meat. Stir. Add vegetables. Stir. Turn on oven. Preheat oven. Place dish in oven. Set timer. Stir pan. Check oven. Turn off induction cooker. Take out dish from oven. Turn off oven. Place food on plates.
Sit at table. Serve food. Pick up fork. Eat dinner. Talk with Member 1. Drink water. Continue eating. Finish meal. Put down fork. Stand up. Clear plates. Walk to kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Cleaning up and loading the dishwasher with Member 1
enriched_activities.desc: Clear table. Scrape food into trash. Rinse plates. Load dishwasher. Add detergent. Close dishwasher. Turn on dishwasher. Wipe counter. Sweep floor. Talk with Member 1. Put away leftovers. Wipe stove. Turn off kitchen light. Walk to living room.

enriched_activities.activity: Leisure time: watching TV and sketching in a sketchbook with Member 1
enriched_activities.desc: Sit on sofa. Turn on TV. Pick up sketchbook. Open sketchbook. Pick up pencil. Draw. Talk with Member 1. Change channel. Continue drawing. Show sketch to Member 1. Laugh. Put down pencil. Stretch. Pick up pencil again. Draw more. Turn off TV. Stand up. Walk to bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Winding down with reading and dim desk lamp light
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to Bedroom 2. Turn on desk lamp. Pick up book. Sit on bed. Open book. Read. Turn pages. Adjust lamp. Read more. Close book. Put down book. Turn off desk lamp. Lie down. Pull blanket up. Close eyes.

enriched_activities.activity: Night routine: brushing teeth and washing face
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Wash face with cleanser. Dry face with towel. Turn off light. Walk to bedroom.
Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn over. Pull blanket up. Continue sleeping.
